backlog_iteration_label: Not committed to a PI iteration yet.
roadmap_unassigned_version_name: Not yet committed to a PI

phases.objective: Create one top-level Epic shell from accepted work without pre-expanding the execution tree.
forbidden_actions: Create PI Objective, User story, Task, or Milestone work during consume.
Use the generic delivery work-item create surface to create a top-level initiative.
exit_criteria: One top-level Epic exists in Workspace Delivery ART.
The roadmap projects the initiative into the uncommitted PI bucket when Target PI is blank.

phases.objective: Shape backlog work while it stays umbrella-sized and uncommitted.
forbidden_actions: Leave backlog Features with executable User story children.
Move non-Epic work into ready, in-progress, or blocked without PI commitment.
exit_criteria: Backlog work stays new unless it is explicitly PI committed.
Backlog Features either remain umbrella-shaped or carry only non-executable planned User story children.

phases.objective: Commit the near-term execution slice with explicit PI placement, iteration, and ownership.
forbidden_actions: Use the backlog iteration label on PI-committed work.
Treat roadmap version as the canonical PI planning field.
PI-commit initiative scope without at least one PI Objective.
exit_criteria: Committed work carries Target PI and non-backlog Iteration.
PI-committed initiative scope includes at least one PI Objective.
Projection-affecting mutations have been captured by the broker projection checkpoint, and checkpoint sync has run before final quality evidence when dirty.
Roadmap version projection matches canonical Target PI or the required derived bucket.
verification_commands: cd ../operator-orchestration-service && npm run art -- projection status
cd ../operator-orchestration-service && npm run art -- projection sync --pi-names "<known-pi-names>" --target-epic-id <epic-id> --quality

phases.objective: Create stories and tasks only for the committed slice that is close enough to execute.
forbidden_actions: Create executable User story or Task work beneath an uncommitted parent.
Pre-expand backlog Features into executable story forests.
Leave a PI-committed Feature without an open User story or Defect child.
exit_criteria: Executable story and task work exists only for committed features or active defects.
PI-committed Features already have an executable User story or Defect leaf front.
Any new or changed committed leaf work has reconciled roadmap version projection at the next broker checkpoint before quality verification.
Active leaf work keeps PI commitment and non-backlog iteration.
verification_commands: cd ../operator-orchestration-service && npm run art -- projection status
cd ../operator-orchestration-service && npm run art -- projection sync --pi-names "<known-pi-names>" --target-epic-id <epic-id> --quality

phases.objective: Execute from the real leaf front instead of the umbrella planning shell.
forbidden_actions: Treat a ready umbrella item as the executable front without checking its continuation context.
Leave an active Feature without an open User story or Defect child.
exit_criteria: The operator can name the leaf story, defect, or task that is the true next front.
Any active Feature retains at least one open User story or Defect child while it stays active.
Execution status changes stay on PI-committed work.

phases.objective: Close completed work, retarget real carryover, and decommit the rest explicitly.
forbidden_actions: Leave open work pointing at the prior PI when it is no longer committed.
Treat PI review as complete without review outcome and actual business value evidence.
exit_criteria: Completed work is closed with evidence.
Open carryover is re-targeted or returned to backlog posture deliberately.
Any carryover, retirement, backlog, or completion state that affects roadmap buckets has run broker projection checkpoint sync before final quality verification.

control_gates.rule: Consume creates one Epic shell only; top-level execution trees are not created during idea handoff.
Top-level delivery initiatives must be created through proposal consume, not through the generic work-item create surface.
Backlog Features may own planned User story children only while those children stay new or parked, blank Target PI, and backlog-iteration only.
Once an initiative holds PI-committed non-Epic work, it must also hold at least one PI Objective.
PI Objective, Task, and Milestone work must carry Target PI; User story work must carry Target PI once executable, active, or PI-committed.
Non-Epic work in ready, in-progress, or blocked must carry Target PI.
PI-committed non-Epic work must carry a non-backlog Iteration and may not keep the backlog iteration label.
Executable User story and Task work may only be created or moved under PI-committed parents; backlog Features may keep new planned User story children as non-executable future decomposition.

After any ART mutation that needs external roadmap version projection reconciliation, the broker CLI records a projection dirty marker. Operators may batch related dirty events, but must run the broker projection sync checkpoint before treating scoped quality or roadmap projection health as final.
OpenProject roadmap version must project exactly from canonical Target PI, or to the explicit unassigned or retired bucket when Target PI is blank.
Feature work that is already PI-committed must keep at least one open User story or Defect child instead of remaining an executable umbrella shell.
Operators confirm continuation context before treating a ready umbrella item as the actionable next work front.
PI review updates must carry review outcome and actual business value for each reviewed PI Objective.
At PI review, open work must be explicitly retargeted to the next PI or moved back to backlog posture instead of keeping stale PI commitment.
